question: Can the sealed 80/10 procedural topology development split produce an auditable 100000-train-frame supervised range-image dataset with complete local structure-event coverage and zero benchmark/test leakage?
method: Use the frozen points-based 5m cluster lattice and terminal-first quota registry; cast ideal 16x720 Open3D CPU LiDAR in two independent scenes, generate 5m spline-sphere outgoing-heading targets with complete mesh LOS and clearance checks, replace failures only by frozen same-world/same-role order, and write 90 split/world Zarr shards plus manifests and train-only previews.
baseline: Frozen RangeExitBaseline B0 is replayed without tuning to report branch-count accuracy; no learned model is trained.

user_authorization.scope: One implementation and one formal Gate-1 data export plus objective teacher generation for 80 train and 10 validation worlds, 22500 clusters and 112500 frames; zero training.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after the final Data Card request, then separately approved Gate 0 to Gate 1 and the isolated E1+Zarr environment.

acceptance_criteria: All frozen tools, environment, registry and 1001-entry M1R source seal match before execution.
Exactly 80 train and 10 validation worlds produce 20000/2500 clusters and 100000/12500 frames in 90 Zarr shards; C10 and M-TARE reads are zero.
Every selected five-frame cluster passes scan shape/dtype/range, minimum horizontal clearance >=0.8m, branch count 1..8, complete 5m branch LOS and independent-scene replay <=1e-6m.
Per-world role quotas match the frozen registry and every junction/terminal event remains represented; no same-world/same-role replacement pool is exhausted.
Student arrays are only range_m and valid_mask; pose, provenance and teacher remain separately identified and leakage audit passes.
Ten fixed train cluster pages and ten train recipe coverage figures are complete; validation/test previews are zero.
Complete within 10800 seconds and 12GiB with complete logs, manifests, metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal; training/models/M-TARE changes remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any source, environment, split, quota, event, scan, teacher, LOS, replay, leakage, preview, time, disk or seal check fails.
Any new world/seed/candidate, cross-world or cross-role replacement, threshold change, partial-label masking, training or M-TARE modification is required.
expected_evidence: 90 split/world Zarr shards; frame, cluster and world manifests; per-world and aggregate metrics.
Objective teacher headings/targets, LOS/clearance records, independent-scene replay and frozen B0 baseline metrics.
Ten train-only recipe coverage figures and ten fixed train-only cluster pages with machine provenance.
Approved Data Card/registry/environment snapshots, raw log, RUN_STATE and complete evidence SHA-256 manifest.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only Open3D 0.19 dual-scene raycast in isolated E1+Zarr; no Gazebo, Isaac, GPU or training.
